decision_rule: WITHIN_BAND if |NPT mean density - 0.805| <= 0.04 x 0.805 g/cm3, the mean being the single value in the deck's density file; OUTSIDE_BAND otherwise; NOT_READ if the equilibration did not finish or the file does not hold exactly one finite positive value. OUTSIDE_BAND or NOT_READ voids the run and labels throughput rows 'descriptive only; anchor failed'; claims B and C (E3b, E3c) then read NOT_READ. Separately: 'density still drifting' if |least-squares slope of the thermo density over the last 100 ps of the NPT run| x 100 ps > 1% of the mean.
metric: anchor: NPT mean density over the last 100 ps of the 300 ps NPT (the deck's density file) against 0.805 g/cm3
